author: claude:factory
source_detail: m2_park_air converts wind and temperature into RUNS and trades KXMLBTOTAL. Air acts on a batted ball's carry, which is a home-run effect first and a runs effect second. KXMLBHR is the cheapest family on the whole exchange's baseball board: a 0.97c bar with 4,899 contracts at the ask.
thesis: Wind and heat change how far a ball carries, so their effect is concentrated in home runs and only reaches the run total second-hand. Trading the home-run market instead of the run total points the same weather information at the thing it actually moves, and does so in the cheapest market on the board.

entry.when: Identical air trigger to the live park-air bot - the same wind and temperature deviations from a normal night at that park, the same park amplifier, the same 30-game park floor - but converted to home runs rather than runs. ASSUMPTION, STATED: about 40 percent of the run effect of air comes through home runs, and one expected home run in a game is worth about 20 cents on an at-the-money home-run market. Enter when net edge after the real ask and the half fee is at least 1.0c.

wrong_if: Result inside plus or minus 1 cent on 300 or more entries.
Its result is no better than park-air's on shared games, which would say the home-run channel is not where the air effect lives.
The 40 percent share turns out to be doing all the work, i.e. the result flips sign if it is set to 25 or 55 percent. A conclusion that depends on a coefficient I invented is not a conclusion.
notes: PAIRED-TESTABLE against park-air, same games, same weather, different instrument. || The 0.97c bar is the lowest of any baseball family measured, which matters more than it sounds: it is roughly a third of a cent cheaper than KXMLBGAME and about half of KXMLBTEAMTOTAL, so the same view clears here that would not clear elsewhere. || Cost bar and ask depth are MEASURED off this project's own recorded tape, not assumed - src/mlb_cost.py, median over every two-sided touch recorded 2026-08-18 to 2026-09-03 between 5c and 95c, with the fee taken at that series' own rate from the census. Both sides of the real touch, never the mid. || Exit is HOLD TO SETTLEMENT on every spec here, deliberately. Mailbox 012: tennis measured exits properly and holding beat selling early in 5 of 5 mentalities, and mlb's own 81-configuration sweep had every stop-loss doing worse than holding. So the exit question is closed and nothing below varies it. These are ENTRY specs only.
